messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Heads up — SigmaAccel reached out about a joint adapter pilot with LangChain next quarter. We need alignment on the integration surface, marketplace listing requirements, and announcement timing. Who can own the connector spec and the marketplace checklist?
Priya (Product): I can own the spec and marketplace checklist. Target: marketplace-ready by 2026-05-10. Need eng ETA and a short beta plan. :calendar:
Jorge (Eng-Platform): We need a small gateway shim + an orchestration hook for routing to SigmaAccel HW. Estimate: ~3 sprints to do M1 + tests. Proposal: ship M1 (read-only connector + auth) first, then M2 adds function-calling + device telemetry. Also we should capture hardware compatibility matrix.
Zoe (DevEx): DevEx can build a quickstart + sample app (LangChain connector + example prompts). I'll need sample creds from SigmaAccel and a short runbook for Dedicated/Private deployments.
Maya (Security): Add me for KMS/HSM review and network egress constraints. If customers will run on Private, we need VPC instructions. Also notify Legal for export controls.
Liam (SigmaAccel): happy to provide test devices + sandbox creds. Can share firmware versions matrix by EOD tomorrow. Also team can join integration call.
IntegrationBot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/specs/sigma-langchain-adapter.md (spec stub) :white_check_mark:
Sam (Partnerships): Thanks — Priya + Jorge, please sync on spec PR by EOD Friday. Zoe, can you draft the sample app template from our existing LangChain connector template? React with ✅ if you can join Thu 10am PT call.
Priya (Product): On it. I'll open GH issue and a PR branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sigma-adapter/issues/1
Jorge (Eng-Platform): Quick technical note: to hit cost/latency targets we should default to batching and KV caching. Suggested golden defaults for initial runs:
```
batch_size: 8
kv_cache: true
fallback_model: "small-optimized"
stream: true
```
These are just defaults, customers can override per-deployment.
Zoe (DevEx): Will reuse the langchain-connector template and add a sample orchestration policy for routing to Dedicated vs Hosted. Any special function-calling surface we need?
Sam (Partnerships): Yes — include a function-calling hook for device_status and start_job. Add that to the spec. Also let's capture testing criteria for marketplace approval (security scan, sample app, 3 customer POCs).
Maya (Security): I'll add a checklist in the spec for KMS keys, network CIDR whitelist, and threat model signoff.
LegalBot: Noted — will route export control and SLA language to contracts. Expect first pass in 2 business days.
Liam (SigmaAccel): We'll provide dummy certs + sandbox endpoints by Thu morning.
Sam (Partnerships): OK — action items captured. I'll schedule the 30-min sync for Thu 10am PT and add a short agenda: spec owners, eng risks, marketplace gate checklist, announcement cadence. Please RSVP. :thumbsup:
